constraints: Identical source pixels and validated options yield identical result pixels.
Transparent areas remain transparent and configured palette ceilings remain bounded.
Applying a mask changes only output alpha and never rewrites source RGB channels.
Locked palettes bound every processed material region to the selected asset family colors.
Every artifact and manifest identifies the result as a reference underpainting.
bindings.handoff_review: Reviewed existing PRODUCT and PRD conversion obligations and deterministic-underpainting assurance association only. process.test covers asserted deterministic pixels, transparency, masking, recipes and scene sizing; locked palette assertion is inclusion rather than exhaustive material palette ceiling proof. cli.test imports run and checks conversion/export metadata and exact partial-alpha scaling; it does not launch installed executable or Aseprite. aseprite.ts is included as imported CLI dependency, not proof of external handoff. Browser and Aseprite behavior IDs remain in inventory but unbound here; missing Aseprite oracle/runtime evidence remains explicit. Child organization remains proposed outside this bounded delivery. No fresh installed user workflow or artist quality acceptance.

decisions.summary: Reviewed existing deterministic conversion source association with canonical PRODUCT and PRD under existing accepted root; browser and Aseprite scopes remain separately incomplete, no new child or maturity acceptance.
